scope: Author inventory for a neutral working paper. Claim linkage is not independent scientific validation. v13 adds analysis and source review, not model predictions.

claims.claim: Evidence containment, evidence precision, annotation agreement, and model faithfulness are different evaluation objects.
claims.scope: Inspected source-specific passages; no native result reproduction.

claims.claim: Behavioral tests, multiple desiderata, explicit validity assumptions, and documented sampling/usage constrain score-to-capability inference.
claims.scope: Each source supports its recorded narrow point, not a theorem about our skill pairs.

claims.claim: Modular compilation, source replay, typed migration, LLM assembly, candidate-conditioned regression validation, content/resource controls, and versioned workflow tasks are distinct comparison mechanisms.
claims.scope: Mechanism review only; no imported empirical score or equivalence of estimands.

claims.claim: Four local endpoints condition on correct labels: full-set sufficient, first-three, exact-annotated, and deliberately incomplete first-annotation-only.
claims.scope: Local cited-pair adaptation; not native SciFact corpus retrieval or aggregate F1.

claims.claim: At-most-k annotation reachability iff shortest rationale size is at most k; sufficient containment is permutation invariant/monotone, exact need not be monotone, first-three need not be permutation invariant.
claims.scope: Fixed enumerated annotations and correct label; elementary derivation, no priority claim.

claims.claim: With fixed Q/weights/outputs, grader-induced contrast change equals joint discrepancy minus mean isolated discrepancy; its magnitude is bounded by joint disagreement probability plus mean isolated disagreement probability.
evidence: linearity and triangle-inequality derivation in paper
claims.scope: Not numerically estimated for real models; does not transport across a changed qualification cohort.

claims.claim: Raw reparse matches 531 prepared tasks/325 components, with 309 evidence tasks/204 components, 222 insufficient tasks, and zero recorded structural split overlaps; all 531 are development exposed.
claims.scope: No semantic duplicate/label adjudication or contamination certification.

claims.claim: Original annotation responses pass sufficient/exact 548/548, first-three 547/548, first-annotation-only 309/548; 239 valid original response alternatives are lost by the incomplete comparator.
claims.scope: 548 responses nested in 309 tasks; no model accuracy or independent response sampling.

claims.claim: Budgets 1–4 make an annotation reachable on 290,305,308,309 evidence tasks; prefix diagnostic curves depend on endpoint.
claims.scope: Reachability is existential; prefix is authored, labels oracle-correct; denominator309.

claims.claim: 548 same-set prepend/append pairs include all309 tasks: first-three has four flips; sufficient/exact have zero order flips.
claims.scope: Added ID is outside annotation union, not independently semantically adjudicated; no natural history incidence.

claims.claim: At k=3, equal-task sufficient expectation0.4903066517 and equal-component0.4961263675; 66,431 real subsets verify the formula, alongside165 small comparisons and5 additional groups.
claims.scope: Finite expectation under correct labels, not random-agent superiority or stochastic confidence.

claims.claim: Actual A/B histories, Q-evaluated pairs, eligible pairs, and assigned S cells are0; theta_Q/tau/witness rate are null.
claims.scope: Null means unestimated, not zero harm. v13 literature HTTP retrieval is separate from the offline run.

claims.claim: Admit grader and answer space before interpreting qualified composition; preserve original alternatives and unreachable cases in accounting.
claims.scope: Engineering recommendation grounded in local audit; not a proof of general measurement validity.

claims.claim: Primary theta_Q compares AB to the mean isolated branch on fresh S given independent common-ancestor Q qualification; family/history weights, yield, missingness, and costs must be declared.
claims.scope: No actual qualified-pair estimate, power calculation, or population claim.

claims.claim: Strong conservative replay, typed repair, and assessment/assembly comparators require equal candidate/feedback/resource rights and charged total budget; inspired adapters and native methods are separate.
claims.scope: No native method win, adapter execution, or newly acquired workflow benchmark.

claims.claim: Independently useful changes may lower completion when jointly available under a fixed application contract.
claims.scope: Requires new real authoring histories, independent Q, fresh S, and controls. Present annotation diagnostics neither prove nor refute its incidence.

prohibited_promotions: Gold-response pass rates must not become LLM composition accuracy.
Constructed strict cells or four order flips must not populate Q-qualified histories.
Negative interaction must not become joint-minus-mean-isolated loss.
Structural split disjointness must not become semantic independence or contamination freedom.
Recent preprint identity or a source hash must not become result truth or novelty certification.
Same-session model review must not become external professor or independent scientific validation.
